summary: Regional Management Corp. filed a Form 8-K on July 29, 2026, reporting second-quarter 2026 financial results, including quarterly net income of $8.2 million and diluted EPS of $0.85, year-to-date net income up 14%, and an 80 basis point improvement in operating expense ratio to 12.4%. The board also declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.30 per share, payable September 16, 2026, to stockholders of record August 19, 2026. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special-situation event. The filing contains no M&A, restructuring, or other extraordinary corporate action; it is a standard operational update with no deal terms.
